header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
Mr. Tulsi Das advocate holding brief on behalf of Mr. Purshotam
None present for the appellant nor any intimation received. Same
body: was the position on last date of hearing. Learned A.P.G also pointed out that this appeal is also barred by 05 days.
Since no one is in attendance on behalf of the appellant, it appears that appellant has lost his interest to proceed with the appeal; therefore, this appeal is dismissed for non-prosecution.
